title: Lab - Archive, back up, compress and redirection
description: Create archives, ship them, and capture command output properly.
scenario: Create archives, ship them, and capture command output properly. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - tar
tasks.instructions: Archive /opt/lab into /tmp/lab.tar.gz, then list its contents without extracting.

tasks.title: Task 2 - rsync
tasks.instructions: Mirror /opt/lab to /backup/lab preserving permissions and deleting files that vanished from the source.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Redirect
tasks.instructions: Run find / -name "*.conf" saving matches to /tmp/conf.txt and errors to /tmp/err.txt.
